newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 126 of May 17, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 126 of May 17, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COUNCIL DECISION of 29 April 1997 appointing one member and two alternate members of the Committee of the Regions
COUNCIL DECISION of 29 April 1997 appointing a member of the Economic and Social Committee
DECISION (EC) No 1/97 OF THE EC-TURKEY ASSOCIATION COUNCIL of 29 April 1997 on the arrangements applicable to certain processed agricultural products

Corrigendum to Council Decision 97/291/EC of 26 April 1997 concerning the conclusions of the Agreement between the European Community and the Republic of Korea on cooperation and mutual administrative assistance in customs matters (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 121 of 13 May 1997)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 893/97 of 16 May 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 892/97 of 16 May 1997 amending the import duties in the cereals sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 891/97 of 15 May 1997 opening a Community tariff quota for certain goods originating from Turkey (1997)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 890/97 of 15 May 1997 opening a Community tariff quota for certain goods originating from Turkey (1996)

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 889/97 of 16 May 1997 fixing the maximum buying-in price and the quantities of beef to be bought in under the 181st partial invitation to tender as a general intervention measure pursuant to Regulation (EEC) No 1627/89
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 888/97 of 16 May 1997 amending certain provisions of the standards for fresh fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 887/97 of 16 May 1997 setting detailed rules to apply Council Regulation (EC) No 712/97 setting up a specific measure in favour of cephalopod producers permanently based in the Canary Islands
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 886/97 of 16 May 1997 on the supply of vegetable oil as food aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 885/97 of 16 May 1997 on the supply of milk products as food aid

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 884/97 of 16 May 1997 suspending the preferential customs duties and re-establishing the Common Customs Tariff duty on imports of small-flowered roses originating in Israel

Corrigendum to Commission Regulation (EC) No 1734/96 of 9 September 1996 amending Annex I to Council Regulation (EEC) No 2658/87 on the tariff and statistical nomenclature and on the Common Customs Tariff (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 238 of 19 September 1996) END OF DOCUMENT.
